::: {#exm-subset-contrapositive}
#### A subset proof by contrapositive

Claim: $\set{x \in \reals : x^3 + x > 0} \subseteq \set{x \in \reals : x > 0}$.

We use the contrapositive outline of @rem-subset-template.
Suppose $a \notin \set{x \in \reals : x > 0}$.
If $a$ is not a real number, then $a$ is not in the left-hand set either,
since every element of that set is a real number.
Otherwise $a$ is a real number with $a \le 0$.
Then $a^3 = a \cdot a^2 \le 0$, since $a \le 0$ and $a^2 \ge 0$, so

$$
a^3 + a \le 0 + 0 = 0.
$$

So $a \notin \set{x \in \reals : x^3 + x > 0}$.

The direct outline would start from "$a^3 + a > 0$",
and would have to get from a cubic back to $a$, which is harder.

:::
